crossRefs.note: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’
saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your…
For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down…
The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by…
even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Yahweh.
But if Yahweh makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up with all that belong to them, and…
“Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”
You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”
Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire…
Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of Yahweh that repays his enemies what they deserve.
You will see it, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones will flourish like the tender grass. Yahweh’s hand will…
Yahweh is a jealous God and avenges. Yahweh avenges and is full of wrath. Yahweh takes vengeance on his adversaries…
But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.
But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
Therefore behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of…
who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all…
forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them…
from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

translations.web: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’ ”
translations.bsb: And these enemies of mine who were unwilling for me to rule over them, bring them here and slay them in front of me.’”
translations.kjv: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.
translations.asv: But these mine enemies, that would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.
